client: Hireloop
client_industry: HR tech
start: 2024-03
end: 2024-05
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python

- FastAPI
- Celery

- semantic search
- background jobs

text: Noor was easy to work with and stayed on top of communication throughout the project.
